cases.ime_probe: After clearing model display name, individual CUA pressKey n/i/h/a/o produced Latin nihao; no visible composition or candidate UI. Real Chinese IME composition, Enter and Escape semantics not established.
cases.typeText: CUA typeText of 你好 Studio🙂e + U+0301 yielded actual field value space+Studioe; Chinese, emoji and combining accent did not arrive. This is a tool/input path observation, not a demonstrated product Unicode fault.
cases.unicode_setValue: CUA setValue inserted 你好 Studio🙂e + U+0301. End+Backspace deleted only U+0301, leaving e; CmdZ restored and CmdShiftZ redid that deletion. Two more Backspaces removed e then full emoji. Home+ShiftRight twice+Backspace removed the two Han characters. After reset, End+Left twice+ShiftLeft+Backspace removed emoji while retaining e+U+0301. No corruption observed in those operations; grapheme-cluster deletion not claimed.
cases.cancel_and_draft: Cancelled Unicode editing sample; model-1 unchanged. CUA setValue 输入验证46🙂, modal Confirm, reopened and observed same value with model-a-1; Escape cancelled reopen. Before provider Save, parent verified Core still model-1 and private draft Unicode value.
cases.noncomposition_latin: Second model setValue Latin46 and field Return confirmed to draft; reopen change to discard-Latin then Escape preserved Latin46; restored model-2 with Return. This is not IME.
cases.save: After screenshots and English language change, Escape cancelled no-change modal; clicked visible Save configuration, UI displayed Saved and log Saved. Parent checks persisted model separately. English selection itself changed Core language so whole config byte-identity no longer applies.
